<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:3">Ber. VI, 3</cite> <he>דבר שאין גִּדּוּלוֹ וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>גִּידּוּלָיו</he> pl.) whatever does not grow out of the soil (animal food &c.); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="C00638"><he>גִּידּוּלִין</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="C00635"><he>גִּידּוּלֵי</he></cite>. Y. ib. V, 9ᶜ top <he>דרך גִּידּוּלֵיהֶן</he> the way they grow, v. <cite ref="C00207"><he>גְּדִילָה</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 7:6">Ned. VII, 6</cite> <he>אסור בחלופיהן</he> (<he>ובגִידּ׳</he>) <he>וּבגִדּוּלֵיהֶן</he> it is forbidden to eat or enjoy what has been exchanged for the fruits or what has grown of their seeds.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 7:6">Ib.</cite> <he>גידולי ג׳</he> growths of the second degree.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 7:3:6">Y. Ter. VII, end, 45ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ איסור</he> products of forbidden seeds.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40b:17">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ קרקע</he> products of the ground; a. fr.
